description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin called 'iframedialog' that adds functionality for creating iframe-based dialog windows within CKEditor. It includes functions to add iframe dialogs and UI elements, handling iframe content loading and resizing.

classes.name: iframeElement
classes.description: A class representing an iframe element within a CKEditor dialog, handling iframe creation, sizing, and content loading.

methods.name: addIframe
methods.description: Creates and adds an iframe-based dialog definition with specified parameters such as name, title, source URL, dimensions, and content load callback.

methods.name: iframeElement (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes an iframe UI element, setting up its HTML, sizing, and content load behavior within the dialog.
